_source: OSRS Wiki, the 'Level up messages' section of each Transcript:<Skill> page, read as raw wikitext by scripts/dump-level-up-messages.cjs. Each level maps to the message(s) the game sends on reaching it, in wiki order; a nested entry carries a 'when' condition built from the transcript's own qualifier, because those levels show a different message per player state; an 'items' list holds the cache ids of the box's picture(s), resolved by exact item name. Magic merges its four spellbook sections, Sailing's beta section is commented out on the wiki and is skipped, and a level the wiki marks only with {{tmissing}} has no message. Messages are verbatim, including their 'Members ...' clause, which OSRS words inline rather than splitting by world type.
